scope: Native default terminal theme, font choice, grid quantization, steady bar cursor and hit testing. Authored app sources are read by the asset generator; app/Android, daemon, worker and wire code unchanged. No installed-client change or production6767 restart.
changes: Generate the authored dark terminal palette, platform font stacks and default code size. Native color projection promotes bold ANSI foregrounds after inverse-role swapping and respects OSC palette/default/cursor overrides.

Resolve system font stack before registering bundled fallback faces. Carry the ordered fallback list into GPUI Font. Linux default is Noto Sans Mono, matching the original runtime. Windows uses the authored Cascadia/Consolas stack.

Derive cell geometry using the selected font, integer browser bounding boxes and WebGL device-pixel rounding. Fit reserves the existing scrollbar width. Mouse/selection/IME coordinates use the same measured geometry.
Steady bar cursor uses the authored color and one-pixel width; OSC12 color reaches the renderer. Empty horizontal-gutter clicks clamp to last column like xterm; unused bottom space sends nothing.
